# BSC (Bharat Steel Group) — Sales Call Knowledge Base (auto-distilled)

## Corpus summary
The uploaded corpus is overwhelmingly **non-sales operational chatter** — crane/loading coordination, driver/trailer booking (Raipur/Nagpur/Tirupati transporters), attendance, MTC/TC document chasing, labour/water-supply questions, wrong numbers, voicemails, and heavily garbled Telugu/Hindi mixed calls. Only a **minority of calls are genuine sales conversations** — rate enquiries, stock checks, cutting/size negotiations, and payment-to-dispatch follow-ups with actual customers (fabricators, traders, EPC/engineering firms, re-sellers in TN/AP). This KB is built strictly from those real sales exchanges (e.g., Tamilarasan Kumar, Thangaraj Metfra, Vinayaga Steel Pradeep, Uniqcore Const Balakrishnan, V R Earth Movers, T Ravikumar/German Polymers, Vidveda, Tirupati Balasubramaniam, Yuvraj Operator cutting-plan calls, Vasanth Narasimhan). Given the dominance of logistics/ops noise, conclusions here should be read as **directional, not exhaustive** — BSC's actual sales process likely has more structure than what surfaces in this sample.

## Products & brand ladder
BSC is a **flat & long steel stockist/re-seller**, not a roofing company. Products actually discussed:

- **MS Plates** (checkered & plain) — thicknesses from 2 mm up to 45 mm+, widths 1250/1500/2000/2500 mm, standard lengths 6300/12000 mm ("sale yard" stock, cut-to-size available).
- **Structural steel** — ISMB beams (e.g., 250, 300x140, 400x140), MS channels (ISMC 200x75), MS angles, flats.
- **TMT bars** — multiple grades: FE500/500D (rare, RINL stopped producing), 550D (main grade available), E250, E350 (E350 BR described as "rare" — "அவ்வளோ Easy-ஆ டக்குன்னு விக்க"). Sizes 8–32 mm.
- **HR Coils** — sold as coil-to-coil or cut-to-plate; cutting from coil costs ~₹500/ton more than full-coil (end-bit) purchase.
- **Conversion/processing service** — cutting plates/coils to customer-specified sizes (sharing size, square plate cutting) via in-house CTL line (Yuvraj Operator calls).
- **NOT dealt by BSC**: Square/rectangular pipes (SHS/RHS), bolts/hangers, net/washer, CR cold-rolled sheet (customer directed to outside vendors) — explicitly stated multiple times: "SHS நம்ம deal பண்றது இல்ல sir", "pipe நாங்க எதுவும் பண்ண மாட்டோம்".

**Brand ladder (make/quality tiers):**
- **Primary/"main" material** = SAIL (சேல்) and RINL/Vizag (referred to as "Vaisakh"/"Vizag sale") — these are BSC's standard stock and are positioned as equivalent in rate: *"Vaisakh-க்கும் sale-க்கும் difference இருக்காது... ரெண்டுமே same price தான்."*
- **NMDC** — used for some plate grades.
- **Tata** — customers often ask for Tata by name; BSC generally does NOT stock Tata ("Tata-ல இல்லை sir, sale மட்டும் தான் இருக்கு") and redirects or substitutes with Sale/Vizag at a claimed ₹2/unit cheaper rate.
- **Secondary/rolling material** — explicitly flagged as cheaper/lower grade when customers quote suspiciously low competitor prices (e.g., channel at ₹57,800 flagged as "அது rolling... Salem Steel Plant ஓட குடுத்துருக்காங்க").

## Real rates & terms (only rates that actually appear in the calls)
- Checker plate 6 mm: **₹65,000 + GST** (German Polymers quotation, later referenced at ₹67,500 + GST in a different call).
- MS Plate 8 mm sheet, 2500 mm width: **₹65,500/ton** (V R Earth Movers), earlier reference to same material at ₹58,000–59,000 before a price run-up.
- Structural beam quotes to Uniqcore Const: **₹71,750 / ₹73,750 / ₹75,750** (size-wise, finalized and matched to approval order).
- ISMB 250 (sale-make): **₹62,500 + GST**, loading & transport extra (Thirisha Enterprise call) — minimum order ~5 tons for base plates/small items.
- Channel 300x140 vs 300x150 comparison: **₹60/kg vs ₹63/kg**, ~₹3,000 difference driven by weight (42 kg/m vs 46 kg/m) and flange thickness.
- TMT/Vizag conversion material (AP market, Tirupati Balasubramaniam thread): rates fluctuating **₹65–₹69/kg** across 8–25 mm, with day-to-day ₹500–₹1,000 moves and dealer-to-dealer bargaining of ₹1–₹3.
- Coil-to-coil vs cut-to-size: **cut pricing is ~₹500/ton higher** than full-coil (end-bit included) purchase — consistent across at least two separate conversations.
- GST & logistics are **always extra**: "+ GST", loading charges, and a standard **"payment/handling charge" of ₹200 per vehicle** (disputed by a customer who was charged ₹250 — resolved via debit note).
- Credit terms: one buyer (Vidveda) confirms BSC gave **1-month credit** on an order after it initially required advance payment — "Credit-ல close ஆயிடுச்சு... 1 month தான்."
